配置自动建造总开关以及本 Mod 允许同时进行的民用建造工程总数上限。
eu5ab_regional_development__general__lim.source_en: Control whether the Mod runs and how many civil projects it may manage at once.
eu5ab_regional_development__general__lim.translation: Contrôlez si le Mod fonctionne et combien de projets civils il peut gérer simultanément.

eu5ab_regional_development__general__ret.translation: Règles de rendement et dérogations d'urgence

eu5ab_regional_development__general__ret.source_zh: 为普通生产建筑设定开工的最低收益门槛，并配置在食物短缺、建材匮乏、战时军需告急或战略原料断供时是否自动放宽收益限制。
eu5ab_regional_development__general__ret.source_en: Choose return requirements for ordinary production buildings and whether shortages of food, construction goods, military goods, or strategic inputs may relax them.
eu5ab_regional_development__general__ret.translation: Définissez le rendement minimal des bâtiments ordinaires et si les pénuries alimentaires, matérielles, militaires ou stratégiques peuvent le lever.

eu5ab_regional_development__finance__bud.source_zh: 全国所有模板、普通建筑与原产扩建共享同一个年度建造预算池。
eu5ab_regional_development__finance__bud.source_en: All built-in templates, custom templates, buildings, and RGOs share one national annual budget pool.
eu5ab_regional_development__finance__bud.translation: Tous les modèles, bâtiments et RGO partagent un seul budget annuel national.

eu5ab_regional_development__finance__mar.source_zh: 设置商品物价偏离基础价格时的供需判定参考百分比。
eu5ab_regional_development__finance__mar.source_en: Set shared minimum and high-price reference percentages relative to default prices.
eu5ab_regional_development__finance__mar.translation: Définissez des pourcentages communs de prix minimal et de référence élevée par rapport au prix de base.

eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.source_zh: 设置特殊建筑、上游补建、劳动力与投入品保护等共享安全限制。
eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.source_en: Shared handling for special buildings, upstream construction, workforce, and input shortages.
eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.translation: Règles communes pour les bâtiments spéciaux, les sources en amont, la main-d'œuvre et les pénuries d'intrants.

eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.source_zh: 配置全国统一的原产自动扩建开关与最低岗位利用率门槛。
eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.source_en: Shared RGO enablement and minimum utilization. Locations are ranked automatically by shortage, price, utilization, and strategic need.
eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.translation: Activation et utilisation minimale communes des RGO. Les lieux sont classés selon pénurie, prix, utilisation et besoin stratégique.

eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.source_zh: 配置测算未来劳动力供给时允许的最长等待期限。
eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.source_en: Shared forecast horizon for filling new jobs.
eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.translation: Horizon commun pour pourvoir les nouveaux emplois.

eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.source_zh: 选择普通建筑的决策排序策略，并设置各类建造行为的先后执行顺序。
eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.source_en: Choose the decision strategy for ordinary buildings, set the order of upgrades, expansions, RGOs, and new buildings, and control local-input influence on supply-demand planning.
eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.translation: Choisissez la stratégie des bâtiments ordinaires, ordonnez améliorations, extensions, RGO et nouvelles constructions, et réglez l'influence des intrants locaux.

eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_ra.source_zh: 选择普通建筑在通过安全与收益前置检查后的最终排序算法。食物危机与「自动建造顺序」层级始终高于此选项；原产扩建按原料紧缺度、物价与利用率独立排序。
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_ra.source_en: Choose how ordinary buildings are selected after they meet construction and return requirements. Food-emergency handling and Automated Build Order always come first. RGO expansion is still ordered by shortage, price, utilization, and strategic need.
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_ra.translation: Choisissez le classement final après les conditions. L'urgence alimentaire et l'Ordre de construction passent d'abord ; les RGO utilisent pénurie, prix, utilisation et besoin stratégique.

eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_ra.source_zh: 根据市场短缺、战略需求、配方效率、本地原料、商品价格和劳动力风险综合安排建造，侧重产业链完整与长期供需稳定。
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_ra.source_en: Arrange construction using market shortages, strategic demand, recipe efficiency, local inputs, commodity prices, and workforce risk, emphasizing complete production chains and stable long-term supply and demand.
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_ra.translation: Classe les projets selon les pénuries du marché, les besoins stratégiques, l'efficacité des recettes, les intrants locaux, les prix et le risque de main-d'œuvre, en favorisant les chaînes complètes et la stabilité à long terme.

eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_ra.source_zh: 先筛选符合模板和安全条件的候选，再按照游戏预测月利润择优建造。利润相近时，0–10 建筑优先级会产生软性影响。
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_ra.source_en: Filter candidates through template and safety rules, then select by the game's predicted monthly profit. The 0–10 building priority has a soft influence when profits are close.
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_ra.translation: Filtre les candidats selon les règles du modèle et de sécurité, puis choisit d'après le bénéfice mensuel prévu par le jeu. La priorité 0–10 n'influence que légèrement les bénéfices proches.

eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.source_zh: 拖动四类建造行为自定义先后顺序（建筑升级、普通扩建、原产扩建、新建建筑）。系统会优先穷尽当前类型中所有可开工项目，再进入下一类型；同类型项目不能开工时会继续寻找同类替代。食物紧急时，产粮项目优先处理但仍遵照此顺序。
eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.source_en: Drag the four types into the order you want. The Mod tries every project it can start in the current type before moving to the next; if one project cannot start, it looks for another of the same type. During a food emergency, food projects are handled first but still follow this order.
eu5ab_regional_development__automation__.translation: Faites glisser les quatre types pour définir l'ordre. Le Mod épuise les projets réalisables du type actuel avant d'avancer et cherche des solutions du même type. En urgence alimentaire, les projets alimentaires passent d'abord tout en gardant cet ordre.

eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.source_zh: 拖动调整建筑升级、普通扩建、原产扩建和新建建筑的先后顺序。
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.source_en: Drag to order building upgrades, ordinary expansions, RGO expansions, and new ordinary buildings.
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.translation: Faites glisser pour ordonner améliorations, extensions ordinaires, extensions RGO et nouveaux bâtiments.

eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.source_zh: 将现有旧式建筑替换为当前已解锁的最新一代升级建筑。
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.source_en: Replace an obsolete building with the newest currently unlocked tier in its upgrade chain.
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.translation: Remplacez un bâtiment obsolète par le niveau débloqué le plus récent de sa chaîne.

eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.source_zh: 为当地已有的普通建筑提升等级，不包含升级替换和原产扩建。
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.source_en: Add a level to an existing ordinary building, excluding replacements and RGOs.
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.translation: Ajoutez un niveau à un bâtiment ordinaire existant, hors remplacements et RGO.

eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.source_zh: 扩建当地原产资源采集点，仍受最低利用率、年度预算和国库储备等规则限制。
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.source_en: Expand the local RGO while retaining the utilization, annual-budget, treasury-reserve, and other safeguards.
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.translation: Étendez le RGO local en conservant les protections d'utilisation, budget annuel, réserve du trésor et autres.

eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.source_zh: 在当地从零新建尚不存在的普通建筑。
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.source_en: Construct an ordinary building from zero where it does not yet exist.
eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_pr.translation: Construisez de zéro un bâtiment ordinaire qui n'existe pas encore dans le lieu.

eu5ab_regional_development__enabled_desc.source_zh: 总开关。关闭后保留所有模板设置与地点绑定，但每月停止执行自动建造检查。
eu5ab_regional_development__enabled_desc.source_en: When disabled, templates and bindings remain saved but monthly automated construction stops.
eu5ab_regional_development__enabled_desc.translation: Si désactivé, modèles et liaisons restent enregistrés, mais la construction automatisée mensuelle s'arrête.

eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_buil.source_zh: 设置在基础 1 项之外，本 Mod 允许同时在建的民用工程上限（范围 0–599，总上限为该数值 + 1）。设为 0 表示全国总计最多 1 个在建项目，599 表示最多 600 个。仅统计由本 Mod 开工且尚未完工的项目；玩家手动建造、道路修筑及其他 Mod 均不占用此名额。
eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_buil.source_en: How many civil projects this Mod may run at once beyond the base slot. 0 means 1 project in total and 599 means 600; manual construction, roads, and projects from other Mods do not use this limit.
eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_buil.translation: Projets civils simultanés au-delà de l'emplacement de base. 0 en autorise 1 au total et 599 en autorise 600. Constructions manuelles, routes et autres Mods ne comptent pas.

eu5ab_regional_development__budget_mode_.source_zh: 选择共享年度预算的计算方式。支持设定固定金币金额，或在每年 1 月按当月国家总收入倍数动态核定。
eu5ab_regional_development__budget_mode_.source_en: Choose a fixed amount or create the shared annual pool from a multiple of monthly total income.
eu5ab_regional_development__budget_mode_.translation: Choisissez un montant fixe ou créez la réserve annuelle commune comme multiple du revenu mensuel total.

eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.translation: Mesure du rendement de la construction automatisée

eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.source_zh: 设置普通生产建筑开工前必须满足的经济回报门槛。可要求游戏预测月收入或月利润为正，或要求年化投资回报率（ROI）达到 5%（约 20 年回本）。不直接产出商品的公共基础设施不受此限制；原产扩建按独立规则评估。
eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.source_en: Choose the return that an ordinary production building must reach before it can start. Income and Profit require a positive monthly value; ROI requires at least a 5% annualized return, or roughly a 20-year payback. Infrastructure without an output is exempt, while RGOs still use utilization, price, and strategic need.
eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.translation: Choisissez le rendement minimal des bâtiments ordinaires : revenu ou bénéfice mensuel positif, ou ROI annuel de 5 %. L'infrastructure sans production est exemptée ; les RGO suivent leurs propres règles.

eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.source_zh: 仅当游戏预测该建筑开工后月收入大于 0 时才允许开工。
eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.source_en: Start an ordinary production building only when the game predicts positive monthly income.
eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.translation: Lancez uniquement si le jeu prévoit un revenu mensuel positif.

eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.source_zh: 仅当游戏预测该建筑扣除维护与原料成本后的月利润大于 0 时才允许开工。
eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.source_en: Start an ordinary production building only when the game predicts positive total monthly profit.
eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.translation: Lancez uniquement si le jeu prévoit un bénéfice mensuel total positif.

eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.source_zh: 仅当游戏预测月收入折算年化收益达到其实际建造成本的 5% 以上时才允许开工。
eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.source_en: Start an ordinary production building only when game-predicted monthly income provides at least a 5% annualized return on its construction cost.
eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.translation: Lancez uniquement si le revenu mensuel prévu représente au moins 5 % annualisés du coût de construction.

eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.source_zh: 仅当游戏预测月利润折算年化收益达到其实际建造成本的 5% 以上时才允许开工（严格防亏损）。
eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.source_en: Start an ordinary production building only when game-predicted monthly profit provides at least a 5% annualized return on its construction cost.
eu5ab_regional_development__economic_met.translation: Lancez uniquement si le bénéfice mensuel prévu représente au moins 5 % annualisés du coût de construction.

eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.source_zh: 预计食物耗尽：优先建造，不检查收益
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.source_en: Food Expected to Run Out: Build First, Ignore Return
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.translation: Épuisement alimentaire prévu : construire d'abord, ignorer le rendement

eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.source_zh: 当所属市场预测食物储备将耗尽时，系统优先调度产粮项目，并对普通食物建筑豁免收益门槛检查。产粮项目内部仍按「自动建造顺序」执行，且预算、国库储备、劳动力及原版建造条件等安全限制依然有效。
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.source_en: When the market is expected to run out of food, handle food projects first and do not require ordinary food buildings to meet the selected return. Food projects still follow Automated Build Order, and all budget, treasury, workforce, input, material, and game construction rules remain in force.
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.translation: Si les aliments vont s'épuiser, traitez d'abord les projets alimentaires et levez le rendement des bâtiments alimentaires ordinaires. L'ordre et toutes les autres règles restent valables.

eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.source_zh: 食物储备不高于 25%：优先建造，不检查收益
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.source_en: Food at or below 25%: Build First, Ignore Return
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.translation: Aliments à 25 % ou moins : construire d'abord, ignorer le rendement

eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.source_zh: 当所属市场食物储备降至 25% 及以下时，系统优先调度产粮项目，并对普通食物建筑豁免收益门槛检查。其他建造与财政安全限制依然有效。
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.source_en: While market food is at or below 25%, handle food projects first and do not require ordinary food buildings to meet the selected return. Food projects still follow Automated Build Order, and every other construction rule remains in force.
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_fo.translation: Avec 25 % d'aliments ou moins, traitez d'abord les projets alimentaires et levez le rendement des bâtiments alimentaires ordinaires ; les autres règles restent valables.

eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_co.source_zh: 建造所需商品供应低于 65%：不检查收益
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_co.translation: Offre de construction sous 65 % : ignorer le rendement

eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_co.source_zh: 当木材、石料、工具等核心建材的市场供应率低于 65% 时，生产对应建材的建筑豁免收益门槛检查，防止因建材昂贵而阻碍经济循环。不会打破建造类型顺序与财政安全线。
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_co.source_en: When a core construction good has less than 65% of the supply it needs, buildings that produce it do not have to meet the selected return. Every other construction rule still applies.
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_co.translation: Si un matériau essentiel reçoit moins de 65 % de l'offre requise, ses producteurs ignorent le rendement. Les autres règles restent valables.

eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_wa.source_zh: 战时军需供应低于 65%：不检查收益
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_wa.source_en: Wartime Military Supply below 65%: Ignore Return
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_wa.translation: Offre militaire en guerre sous 65 % : ignorer le rendement

eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_wa.source_zh: 当国家处于战争状态且军需品的市场供应率低于 65% 时，生产对应军需装备的建筑豁免收益门槛检查，确保战时物资供应。
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_wa.source_en: While at war, if a military good has less than 65% of the supply it needs, buildings that produce it do not have to meet the selected return. Every other construction rule still applies.
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_wa.translation: En guerre, si un bien militaire reçoit moins de 65 % de l'offre requise, ses producteurs ignorent le rendement ; les autres règles restent valables.

eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_st.source_zh: 战略生产缺料：不检查上游收益
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_st.source_en: Strategic Production Lacks Inputs: Ignore Upstream Return
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_st.translation: Production stratégique sans intrants : ignorer le rendement en amont

eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_st.source_zh: 当关键上游原料供应率低于 65%，且已导致本国食物、建材或军需生产受阻时，生产该原料的上游建筑豁免收益门槛检查，以尽快打通产业链堵点。
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_st.source_en: When an upstream good has less than 65% of the supply it needs and that shortage has stopped a domestic food, construction, or military building, producers of that upstream good do not have to meet the selected return. Every other construction rule still applies.
eu5ab_regional_development__emergency_st.translation: Si un intrant en amont sous 65 % bloque une production nationale alimentaire, de construction ou militaire, ses producteurs ignorent le rendement ; les autres règles restent valables.

eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual.source_zh: 仅在固定预算模式下生效；全国所有模板共享该年度总额度。
eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual.source_en: Used only in fixed mode; every template shares this amount.
eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual.translation: Utilisé uniquement en mode fixe ; tous les modèles partagent ce montant.

eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_res.source_zh: 设置国库最低保留金币底线（范围 0–100,000，步长 100）。若开工扣除建造成本后国库余额会低于此数值，则强制拦截建造，防止国库见底或陷入赤字。
eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_res.source_en: Gold that must remain in the treasury after a project starts.
eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_res.translation: Or qui doit rester dans le trésor après le lancement d'un projet.

eu5ab_regional_development__price_min_de.source_zh: 产出品在所属市场的当前物价低于基础价格此比例时，视为产能过剩并禁止新建或扩建（默认 80%）。
eu5ab_regional_development__price_min_de.source_en: Output below this percentage of default price is normally treated as oversupplied.
eu5ab_regional_development__price_min_de.translation: Une production sous ce pourcentage du prix de base est normalement considérée excédentaire.

eu5ab_regional_development__price_max_na.translation: Pourcentage de référence de prix élevé

eu5ab_regional_development__price_max_de.source_zh: 产出品在所属市场的当前物价高于基础价格此比例时，视为物资紧缺并在供需规划中给予高额排序加分（默认 125%）。
eu5ab_regional_development__price_max_de.source_en: Output above this percentage of default price receives a ranking bonus.
eu5ab_regional_development__price_max_de.translation: Une production au-dessus de ce pourcentage du prix de base reçoit un bonus de classement.

eu5ab_regional_development__allow_specia.source_zh: 开启后，模板允许建造符合条件的特殊建筑（如宗教、文化或特定奇观类建筑）。关闭后自动建造将忽略所有特殊建筑。
eu5ab_regional_development__allow_specia.source_en: Allow automated construction to consider special buildings; the game's own construction requirements still apply.
eu5ab_regional_development__allow_specia.translation: Autorisez les bâtiments spéciaux ; les conditions de construction du jeu restent valables.

eu5ab_regional_development__auto_build_i.translation: Construire les sources en amont en cas de pénurie

eu5ab_regional_development__auto_build_i.source_zh: 开启后，当下游普通建筑因原料严重短缺而无法开工时，系统会自动尝试转为建造模板允许且能提供该原料的上游产业。
eu5ab_regional_development__auto_build_i.source_en: When a planned building cannot start because inputs are scarce, try an allowed upstream source.
eu5ab_regional_development__auto_build_i.translation: Si un bâtiment prévu ne peut commencer faute d'intrants, essayez une source en amont autorisée.

eu5ab_regional_development__pause_low_wo.source_zh: 开启后，若评估地点在指定预测期限内无法提供足额劳动力填补新岗位，则直接拦截开工；关闭后仅降低该项目的建造优先级。
eu5ab_regional_development__pause_low_wo.source_en: Do not build a project when its jobs cannot be filled within the forecast period.
eu5ab_regional_development__pause_low_wo.translation: Ne construisez pas si les emplois ne peuvent être pourvus dans la période prévue.

eu5ab_regional_development__stop_input_s.source_zh: 关键投入品短缺时停止
eu5ab_regional_development__stop_input_s.translation: Arrêter en cas de pénurie d'intrants critiques

eu5ab_regional_development__stop_input_s.source_zh: 开启后，若生产所需的核心工业原料在市场上的供应率低于 75%，则暂停新建或扩建对应工厂，避免建好后因缺料停工。
eu5ab_regional_development__stop_input_s.source_en: Do not build related projects while critical market inputs are undersupplied.
eu5ab_regional_development__stop_input_s.translation: Ne construisez pas les projets concernés tant que les intrants critiques du marché sont sous-approvisionnés.

eu5ab_regional_development__allow_rgo_de.source_zh: 开启后，允许所有模板在满足条件时自动扩建当地原产资源采集点。
eu5ab_regional_development__allow_rgo_de.source_en: Allow every template to consider expanding resource locations.
eu5ab_regional_development__allow_rgo_de.translation: Autorisez tous les modèles à envisager l'extension des lieux de ressources.

eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_min_util.source_zh: 设置原产扩建的当前岗位利用率门槛（默认 75%）。低于此利用率的原产不会扩建，避免盲目扩建缺工人的资源点。
eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_min_util.source_en: Do not expand an RGO below this utilization.
eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_min_util.translation: N'étendez pas un RGO sous ce niveau d'utilisation.

eu5ab_regional_development__job_fill_dea.source_zh: 评估劳动力承载力时的最长等待期限（可在 0—96 个月之间调整）。系统会根据当前空闲人口及期限内能够晋升到对应阶层的人数进行保守测算；设为 0 表示只考虑当前现成劳动力。
eu5ab_regional_development__job_fill_dea.source_en: Forecast horizon for local promotion into new jobs.
eu5ab_regional_development__job_fill_dea.translation: Horizon de prévision des promotions locales vers les nouveaux emplois.

eu5ab_regional_development__native_input.source_zh: 调节本地原料在「供需规划」中的加权权重（范围 0–10，默认 5）。数值越高，能直接消耗本省所产原料的制造类建筑在排序时加分越多；0 表示不提供本地原料排序加分，其他投入品和市场供需判断仍照常生效。
eu5ab_regional_development__native_input.source_en: 0–10; higher values make buildings that can use raw materials from the same province more likely to be built first.
eu5ab_regional_development__native_input.translation: 0–10 ; des valeurs élevées favorisent les bâtiments utilisant les matières premières de la même province.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 性能预设
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Performance Preset
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Préréglage de performances

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 性能预设会自动联动下方高级参数。手动修改高级设置后会自动切换为「自定义」，并于下一次月度检查开始生效。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: A preset synchronizes the advanced settings below. Custom retains their current values.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Un préréglage synchronise les options avancées ci-dessous. Personnalisé conserve leurs valeurs actuelles.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 保守
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Conservative
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Prudent

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 每天最多检查 10 个地点，每轮最多新增 30 个项目；规划候选数为 5、利润候选数为 15（分别仅用于对应策略），找到足够候选后停止检查剩余地点。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Check up to 10 locations per day and start at most 30 projects per run. Planning Candidates is 5 and Profit Candidates is 15, each used only by its matching strategy. Stop checking remaining locations once enough candidates are available.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Vérifie jusqu'à 10 lieux par jour et lance au plus 30 projets par passage. Candidats de planification : 5 ; de bénéfice : 15. S'arrête dès qu'il y en a assez.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 平衡
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Balanced
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Équilibrée

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 每天最多检查 20 个地点，每轮最多新增 50 个项目；规划候选数为 4、利润候选数为 12（分别仅用于对应策略），找到足够候选后停止检查剩余地点。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Check up to 20 locations per day and start at most 50 projects per run. Planning Candidates is 4 and Profit Candidates is 12, each used only by its matching strategy. Stop checking remaining locations once enough candidates are available.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Vérifie jusqu'à 20 lieux par jour et lance au plus 50 projets par passage. Candidats de planification : 4 ; de bénéfice : 12. S'arrête dès qu'il y en a assez.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 效率优先
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Maximum Throughput
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Débit maximal

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 适合已应用模板地点较多的国家。每天最多检查 30 个地点，不限制本轮新增数；规划候选数为 3、利润候选数为 10（分别仅用于对应策略），找到足够候选后停止检查剩余地点。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Best for countries with many assigned locations. Check up to 30 locations per day with no per-run project limit. Planning Candidates is 3 and Profit Candidates is 10, each used only by its matching strategy. Stop checking remaining locations once enough candidates are available.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Pour les pays avec beaucoup de lieux. Vérifie jusqu'à 30 lieux par jour sans limite par passage. Candidats de planification : 3 ; de bénéfice : 10. S'arrête dès qu'il y en a assez.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 自定义
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Custom
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Personnalisé

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 使用当前自定义配置的高级性能参数。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Use the current advanced settings.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Utilisez les paramètres avancés actuels.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 大量地点应用模板可能降低游戏性能。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Many templated locations can reduce game performance.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: De nombreux lieux avec modèles peuvent réduire les performances.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 效率优先模式下每天处理最多 30 个地点且不限每轮新增数。国家规模极大时可能导致月结卡顿。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Maximum Throughput processes up to 30 locations per day with unlimited additions per run. Many templated locations can reduce game performance.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Débit maximal traite jusqu'à 30 lieux par jour sans limiter les ajouts par passage. Beaucoup de lieux peuvent ralentir le bilan mensuel.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 供需规划卡顿：降低「规划候选数」。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Supply-Demand slowdown: lower Planning Candidates.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Ralentissement Offre et demande : réduisez les Candidats de planification.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 仅在供需规划时显示。降低「规划候选数」可以减少每个地点、每种普通建造类别接受后续检查的项目数量。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Shown only with Supply-Demand Planning. Lowering Planning Candidates reduces the projects per location and ordinary build category sent to later checks.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Affiché uniquement en Offre et demande. Moins de Candidats de planification réduit les projets par lieu et type envoyés aux vérifications suivantes.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 后果：失败回退减少，可能漏掉后续可行项目。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Tradeoff: fewer fallbacks may miss later feasible projects.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Compromis : moins de solutions peuvent manquer des projets réalisables.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 规划候选使用相同规划分排序。降低上限会减少高分项目检查失败后的回退选择，因此可能出现前几名失败、后续项目原本可建却未被检查的情况。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Planning candidates share the same planning-score order. A lower limit leaves fewer fallbacks when higher-scoring projects fail, so a feasible later project may never be checked.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Les candidats suivent le même score de planification. Une limite basse laisse moins de solutions si les premiers échouent et peut ne pas vérifier un projet ultérieur réalisable.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 预测利润择优卡顿：降低「利润候选数」。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Profit-selection slowdown: lower Profit Candidates.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Ralentissement de sélection du bénéfice : réduisez les Candidats de bénéfice.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 仅在预测利润择优时显示。降低「利润候选数」可以减少每个地点、每种普通建造类别接受游戏预测利润与成本检查的项目数量。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Shown only with Predicted Profit Selection. Lowering Profit Candidates reduces the projects per location and ordinary build category sent to game-predicted profit and cost checks.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Affiché uniquement avec la Sélection par bénéfice prévu. Moins de Candidats de bénéfice réduit les projets par lieu et type envoyés aux vérifications de bénéfice et coût du jeu.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 后果：粗筛范围缩小，可能漏掉真实高利润建筑。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Tradeoff: a smaller shortlist may miss truly profitable buildings.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Compromis : une liste réduite peut manquer des bâtiments réellement rentables.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 利润策略先按规划分粗筛、再按游戏预测利润排序。降低上限会增加高利润建筑在粗筛阶段被提前淘汰的可能性。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Profit selection prefilters by planning score and then orders by game-predicted profit. A lower limit makes it more likely that a high-profit building is discarded during prefiltering.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: La sélection du bénéfice préfiltre par score puis classe selon le bénéfice prévu. Une limite basse peut éliminer un bâtiment rentable au préfiltrage.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 也可降低每天检查地点和每轮新增。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Also lower daily locations or additions per run.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Réduisez aussi les lieux quotidiens ou les ajouts par passage.

eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_zh: 降低每天检查地点上限会把全国扫描分散到更多天；降低每轮最多新增会减少单轮校验和开工量。也可直接更换性能预设；每轮最多新增为 0 时表示无限。
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.source_en: Lowering Locations Checked per Day spreads a nationwide scan across more days. Lowering Maximum Additions per Run reduces validation and construction starts per run. You can also change preset; zero Maximum Additions means unlimited.
eu5ab_regional_development__performance_.translation: Moins de lieux par jour répartit le balayage sur davantage de jours. Moins d'ajouts réduit les vérifications et lancements par passage. Vous pouvez aussi changer le préréglage ; zéro ajout signifie illimité.

eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_loc.source_zh: 开启后，每个地点会作为独立任务检查，以减少单次处理时间；关闭后则在每日批次中依次检查。两种方式都会分布在多日进行，且不改变项目排序、预算或建造顺序。
eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_loc.source_en: Check locations separately so a single update takes less time. This does not change project ranking, budget, or build order.
eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_loc.translation: Vérifiez les lieux séparément pour réduire la durée d'une mise à jour. Cela ne change ni le classement, ni le budget, ni l'ordre.

eu5ab_regional_development__daily_locati.source_zh: 每天最多深度扫描的地点数量（范围 1–30）。数值越低每日计算开销越小，但覆盖全国所需天数越多。
eu5ab_regional_development__daily_locati.source_en: Maximum locations checked in detail each day, from 1 to 30. Lower values reduce daily processing but take longer to cover the country.
eu5ab_regional_development__daily_locati.translation: Maximum de lieux vérifiés en détail par jour, de 1 à 30. Une valeur basse réduit le traitement quotidien mais allonge la couverture du pays.

eu5ab_regional_development__max_addition.source_zh: 限制单轮月度调度中允许开工的最大项目数（范围 0–600，0 表示不设上限）。
eu5ab_regional_development__max_addition.source_en: Limit the maximum projects started in one run, from 0 to 600. Zero means unlimited.
eu5ab_regional_development__max_addition.translation: Limitez les projets lancés en un passage, de 0 à 600. Zéro signifie illimité.

eu5ab_regional_development__candidates_p.source_zh: 仅在「供需规划」策略下显示并生效。每个地点、每种普通建造类别最多保留多少个规划分最高的候选用于检查（范围 3–30）。第 2 名以后用于在更高分候选未通过投入品、过剩、预算或游戏条件时回退；数值越高越不容易漏掉后续可行项目，但会增加检查次数。
eu5ab_regional_development__candidates_p.source_en: Shown and used only by Supply-Demand Planning. Sets how many top planning-score candidates per location and ordinary build category are checked, from 3 to 30. Candidates after the first provide fallbacks when higher scores fail input, oversupply, budget, or game-condition checks. Higher values reduce missed fallbacks but increase checks.
eu5ab_regional_development__candidates_p.translation: Uniquement en Offre et demande. Conserve 3 à 30 candidats par lieu et type. Plus de candidats offrent des solutions si les premiers échouent, mais augmentent les vérifications.

eu5ab_regional_development__actual_profi.source_zh: 仅在「预测利润择优」策略下显示并生效。每个地点、每种普通建造类别最多保留多少个粗筛候选，交由游戏预测利润继续比较（范围 3–30）。数值越高越不容易漏掉真实高利润建筑，但会增加成本与收益检查次数。
eu5ab_regional_development__actual_profi.source_en: Shown and used only by Predicted Profit Selection. Sets how many prefiltered candidates per location and ordinary build category are sent to the game's predicted-profit comparison, from 3 to 30. Higher values reduce shortlist misses but increase cost and return checks.
eu5ab_regional_development__actual_profi.translation: Uniquement en Sélection par bénéfice. Envoie 3 à 30 candidats par lieu et type à la comparaison du jeu. Plus de candidats réduit les omissions mais augmente les vérifications.

eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_w.source_en: Stop Checking When Enough Candidates Are Found
eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_w.translation: Arrêter quand assez de candidats sont trouvés

eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_w.source_zh: 当收集到的合格候选达到本轮最大新增数的 2 倍后，立即终止对剩余地点的扫描，节省计算资源。
eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_w.source_en: Once qualifying candidates reach twice the maximum projects for this run, stop checking remaining locations to avoid unnecessary work.
eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_w.translation: Quand les candidats admissibles atteignent deux fois le maximum du passage, cessez de vérifier les lieux restants.

eu5ab_diagnostics_cmm_hint.source_zh: 全国共享规则请在社区模组框架的「模组设置」中配置；「建造报告」展示最近一次月度建造结果。
eu5ab_diagnostics_cmm_hint.source_en: Change shared rules in Community Mod Framework's Mod Settings. Construction Report shows the latest automated construction result.
eu5ab_diagnostics_cmm_hint.translation: Modifiez les règles communes dans les Paramètres de mod de Community Mod Framework. Le rapport de construction affiche le dernier résultat automatisé.
